Together, your sparks form your light, and your level is read from it. A million sparks for level 100, and a trial every ten levels: until it is passed, your light waits. Twenty phases. Levels climb up to 499; the Ambassador rank opens them up to 1,000, and the Oracle rank opens them without limit. Each level asks for a little more than the one before.

Your level restarts at 1 and your sparks at 0; your rank, glory and Meeshes stay. Your ancestors offer you a numbered trophy and %1$s glory.
Purely decorative: a collectible every %1$s stops.

Concepts
Your level drops by as much; your rank and medals don’t drop.
Mints, new levels and great deeds grow your glory, which gives your rank.
Keeping Meeshes grows your legacy; spending them watches over the Flame.
A dream each night, an Offering, a Flame that grows as you come back.
The Meesh is your light bound into a numbered coin.
One in a hundred is gold, one in a thousand prism.
All your Vigils are here.
Each sign from your ancestors can become a photo here.

Your level is the number at the centre of your ring: it is read from your light.
A Vigil guards it for one day away.
Open an act to see where you stand. You can change one a day with a Meesh.
Your joust and your alliance stay open.
Your joust name is drawn at random and changes with every journey.
Ranking set every day at 4 a.m.: nobody sees who is playing right now. Only your row is live.
Acts and alliances carry you a few strides. The whole journey is free.
